assertions.text: Runs the merge-commit count check (gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/<number>/commits, counting entries with more than one parent) before ever calling gh pr merge --rebase
Since the count is non-zero, asks via AskUserQuestion for an alternate strategy (Merge or Squash) instead of attempting --rebase
States why: GitHub's rebase-and-merge rejects a branch containing an existing merge commit
Does not wait for a live gh pr merge --rebase rejection before asking
